decisions.reason: The firm has likely invested substantially in development and marketing of this desk system, and its fit with flexible premium workplace interiors makes management inclined to treat any weak results as temporary rather than exit.
As a chair family close to the core offer, it benefits from strong strategic fit, visible prior commitment, and a broad-range portfolio logic that favors persistence.
Although more niche, it still builds on the firm's material and interior expertise, so sunk design effort and a willingness to wait for market acceptance support continuation.
The sofa received an explicit, public designer-led launch and sits near the heart of the firm's premium living offer, which makes management especially likely to stay committed.
This standing table aligns with the firm's direction toward adaptable work and meeting spaces, and earlier investment and public presentation encourage management to give it more time.

Despite prior promotion, the rug collection is the most distant from the established furniture business, so it is the easiest line to cut when management reallocates resources while still defending its core commitments.
